text_block_list.text:
One day, Rulership and the others held an 
overnight training camp in preparation for 
the team Seven Bridge tournament.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Playing cards really are great. From how 
they're used to the designs on them, 
they're packed with secrets to being loved 
for ages.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I agree. Though it's only 52 cards, 
there are infinite ways to play—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! That's not the point! Please 
focus on Seven Bridge right now!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. No matter how many times I look 
at them, I just think it's such great 
design...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it's a lonely number... I shall 
connect them continuously. On and on, as 
far as it can go...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A strong mindset to connect is indeed a 
weapon— But your turn is already over! 
Just how long do you intend to keep 
playing cards...?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My deepest apologies, I got carried 
away...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The newcomers Pisa and Logo aren't easy to 
handle either... And the existing members 
haven't even fallen into place yet...!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ruler-senpai. Can I go run up the 
mountain? I want to build up more momentum 
for laying down cards.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ruler, I really can't just pass! 
Destiny is telling me to go, to attack!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You guys are coming up with outrageous 
things again... Alright, fine!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
First, everyone needs to master the 
fundamentals of Seven Bridge perfectly. 
Then we can talk!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You can only pass up to 3 times. You 
shouldn't waste them thoughtlessly, but 
hoarding them too stubbornly isn't good 
either!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Then please give me instructions during 
the match. I will follow them.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Instructing which cards to play is against 
the rules. The final decision is up to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if you have playable numbers, 
deliberately passing to stall your 
opponent's momentum is also a valid 
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, let's start with one practice 
game with everyone showing their hands 
open—

And so, Rulership spent the whole night 
teaching them the basics—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, well done. The fundamentals 
learned during this camp will definitely 
prove useful!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wait, all we did was basicssss~~! Heading 
into the tournament like this?! 
Impossible, impossible, impossible!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What should I do, extend the camp? No, our 
schedules won't allow it!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...There has to be a way out. I'll think 
it through until the very last second.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis takes the initiative... and 
Epi wants to charge ahead too? If that 
happens, Logo gets left behind—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, this can't form a viable 
plan~~! Give me a break, this is total 
garbage design!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*, why am I making a mess before 
going home? I need to clean up... Haha, 
this mess looks just like our team right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? It's unmanageable... A team 
scattered all over the place, just like 
these playing cards—

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's my turn. Can you keep up 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't mind me. I'll pass... and the 
next turn, and the turn after that too.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I will connect them. Here, and here. And 
here as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Motion and stillness! Two completely 
opposing playstyles striking at once, 
forcing the opponents onto high alert...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What's more, it's an incidental combo! 
There's no way to read their 
intentions...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Phalaeno's pressure, along with Epi and 
Eff's relentless drive. Heh, there was 
never any need to micromanage them.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My role is simply to roll the dice. And 
set up the stage for them—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see it now... We can do this, we can 
totally do this. We can dominate the board 
as a team...!

One day, on the way to the academy, 
Rulership called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There's a team Seven Bridge tournament 
coming up soon. Would you like to come 
watch if you're free?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to make it quite the special 
match. I highly recommend experiencing 
that excitement in person.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, victory is already a foregone 
conclusion. There is only one thing you 
need to witness.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And that is what kind of strategy we'll 
use to win— that's all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My predicted win rate for tournament day 
is 100%. Heheh, it'd be stranger if I 
lacked confidence.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, these aren't just empty words— 
I shall prove it through results.
